programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Today’s Glasgow show kicks off at music venue come restaurant Bloc where head chef Andy and front of house Pixie serve up a feast of calorific street food. programme.title: Asia Unplated

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: The celebration of Cantonese cooking begins in one of Melbourne’s most iconic restaurants, Flower Drum, in the heart of Chinatown. For the main course, Diana creates ‘Pak Cham Kai’ by poaching a whole chicken in a pot with aromatics and topping with infused oil – Cantonese home cooking, simple yet delicious.
